name: Cloud of Reverie OLD
description: A cloud of shimmering blue dust erupts from the chest and lingers in the air.
disable: DC 23 Religion or DC 23 Medicine to recognize the distinct aroma as belonging to incense of reverie and take necessary precautions when opening the chest, such as holding one's breath and shielding the face from exposure.

generalAbilities.name: Incense Cloud
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger The chest is opened

Effect All creatures within 10 feet of the chest inhale the dust and become Fascinated and Fatigued (Basic DC 20 Fortitude Saving Throw save to negate both effects). The fascinated effect lasts for 1 minute, as the target enters a calm and dreamy stupor looking at into the receding dust mist. As usual, the fatigued condition lasts until the affected creature receives a full night's rest.
